entries.text: As per 口# (cavity) + 八 split right and left (doubled) → a circular cavity in the earth from which water spouts → *sunken fountainhead*; *valley*; *ravine*; *canyon* (← sunken spot).
泉出通川爲谷。从水半見，出於口。凡谷之屬皆从谷。

穀.example: 山谷 → 山谷; 五谷 → 五穀
穀.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

entries.text: 望山谷谸谸青也。从谷千聲。

As per 牙# (mesh; cross) + 谷 valley → crossing point of two or more gorges → *gorge*. *Echo* is an associated meaning (← sound crossing between gorges). In ancient Japan, echoes were believed to emanate from *tree spirits*.
相踦之也。从丮𧮫聲。
As per 奚# (aligned) + 谷 valley → *valley river* aligned to the contours of its *valley*. Compare 溪.
山瀆无所通者。从谷奚聲。
As per 害# (cut) + 谷 (cavity) → cut in scooping out a *wide* opening → *open*. Compare 闊.
空谷也。从谷翏聲。
大長谷也。从谷龍聲。讀若聾。
A depiction of a bean-shaped food stand → *bean*; *pea*; *pulse* (← resemblance in shape) → *miniature* (← small object ← small as a bean).
古食肉器也。从口，象形。凡豆之屬皆从豆。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 豆 bean → long pod of the *black-eyed pea*, to which the fruit are connected.
A depiction of a stand bearing a pile of food in neat alignment (compare 宜). *How* and *what* (exclamations of surprise) are borrowed meanings, as is *covet* (via 覬).
還師振旅樂也。一曰欲也，登也。从豆，微省聲。凡豈之屬皆从豈。
As per 支# (skillfully manipulate) + 豆 bean → mash beans and create a fermented paste → *fermented soybean paste* (miso).
行禮之器也。从豆，象形。凡豊之屬皆从豊。讀與禮同。
As per 宛# (circular) + 豆 bean → round peas (in a flexible pod) → *pea*.

豆# a stand + 臤 (adhere) → a *vertical/upright* stand adhering to the floor. *Child* slave/servant is a borrowed meaning, likely influenced by the meaning of the 臣 element in 臤 when functioning as an independent character. 竪 is a variant form of 豎.
豎立也。从臤豆聲。

豆 food stand + an element# combining 山 mountain and 丰 cone-shaped, fruit-bearing ears of grain (doubled) → abundant grain piled high in a cone shape on a food stand → *abundance*; *rich*. Distinguish this element from the right-hand element of 禮, which is etymologically unrelated.
豆之豐滿者也。从豆，象形。一曰《鄉飲酒》有豐侯者。凡豐之屬皆从豐。
爵之次弟也。从豊从弟。《虞書》曰：“平豑東作。”
好而長也。从豐。豐，大也。盇聲。《春秋傳》曰：“美而豔。”
A depiction of a *pig* or boar with a long snout.
彘也。竭其尾，故謂之豕。象毛足而後有尾。讀與豨同。(桉：今丗字，誤以豕爲彘，以彘爲豕。何以明之？爲啄琢从豕，蟸从彘。皆取其聲，以是明之。)凡豕之屬皆从豕。
豕絆足行豖豖。从豕繫二足。
An abbreviated form# of 彖 (pig) + 肉 flesh → (corpulent) *pig/hog*. 豚 was devised to replace 彖 after 彖 came to refer to divination.
小豕也。从彖省，象形。从又持肉，以給祠祀。凡豚之屬皆从豚。
上谷名豬豭。从豕，役省聲。
牝豕也。从豕巴聲。一曰一歲，能相把拏也。《詩》曰：“一發五豝。”
豕屬。从豕且聲。

A depiction of an *elephant* → *tusk*; *ivory* → *shape*; *image*; *appearance* (animal of a conspicuous/remarkable shape etc.) → *liken*; *resemble* (← image resembling the original object) → *imitate* (← image resembling/imitating the original object) . The pronunciation of the character simulates the trumpeting of an elephant.
長鼻牙，南越大獸，三秊一乳，象耳牙四足之形。凡象之屬皆从象。
As per 𠔉# as described in 券 (wrap/roll up) + 豕 pig/boar → pigs or other *domestic animals* contained in a circular pen (compare 圂) → *raise*; *feed*; *entrap*.
以穀圈養豕也。从豕𢍏聲。
三歲豕，肩相及者。从豕幵聲。《詩》曰：“並驅从兩豣兮。”
齧也。从豕𥃩聲。
鬬相丮不解也。从豕、虍。豕、虍之鬬，不解也。讀若蘮蒘草之蘮。司馬相如說：豦，封豕之屬。一曰虎兩足舉。
豕息也。从豕甫聲。
豕走豨豨。从豕希聲。古有封豨脩虵之害。
二豕也。豳从此。闕。

An abbreviated form# of 高 tall/high + 豕 pig/boar (→ wild animal) → porcupine (← small animal likened to a pig that, when threatened, arches its back and makes its protective needles stand on end) → *magnificent*; *powerful*; *wealthy*; *luxurious* (← stand tall ← stand on end).
As per 予# (stretch) + 象 elephant → space sufficient for even a large animal to stretch and relax.
象之大者。賈侍中說：不害於物。从象予聲。
豕而三毛叢居者。从豕者聲。
As per 叚# (overlay) + 豕 pig/boar → tusked *boar* (← tusks that overlay the mouth) → *male pig*.
牡豕也。从豕叚聲。
生三月豚，腹豯豯皃也。从豕奚聲。
小豚也。从豕𣪎聲。
逸也。从豕原聲。《周書》曰：“豲有爪而不敢以撅。”讀若桓。

豩 combines 豕 pig/boar + an abbreviated form of the top element of 賓 (pigs spread tightly throughout a pigpen) → swarm/throng of pigs. To 豩# (swarm), 豳 adds 山 mountain → *mountainous region* (originally, one swarming with boars/wild pigs). The character also was applied to a particular *Zhou Dynasty kingdom*.
生六月豚。从豕從聲。一曰一歲豵，尚叢聚也。
羠豕也。从豕賁聲。
豕息也。从豕壹聲。《春秋傳》曰：“生敖及豷。”
A depiction of an *animal* that ambles along the ground.
獸長𦟝，行豸豸然，欲有所司殺形。凡豸之屬皆从豸。(司殺讀若伺候之伺。)
豸 animal that ambles along the ground + 勺# (rise and become evident) → *leopard*/*panther* leaping in attack. For the idea of a leaping animal, compare 麃.
似虎，圜文。从豸勺聲。
As per 才# (cut off) + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → dog or wolf-like *wild animal* that rips prey apart in eating → *greedy/avaricious person*.
狼屬，狗聲。从豸才聲。
胡地野狗。从豸干聲。
獸，無前足。从豸出聲。《漢律》：“能捕豺貀，購百錢。”
鼠屬。善旋。从豸穴聲。
鼠屬。大而黃黑，出胡丁零國。从豸召聲。
As per 休# (curl up/around) + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → *fierce beast* (trained for attack in battle, that curls around its victim; compare 貔) → *courageous soldier*.
貉之類。从豸亘聲。
似狐，善睡獸。从豸舟聲。《論語》曰：“狐貈之厚以居。”
As per 各# (hard) + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → slow-moving animal with a ferocious (= hard) bite → *badger*. The variant form 狢 replaces 豸 with 犬 dog/beast.
北方豸穜。从豸各聲。孔子曰：“貉之爲言惡也。”
As per 皃# (obscure figure) + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → obscure figure (of an animal) → *appearance*; *external aspects*.
伏獸，似貙。从豸里聲。
猰貐，似貙，虎爪，食人，迅走。从豸俞聲。
獸也。从豸耑聲。讀若湍。
豸 animal that ambles along the ground + 苗# for the sound alone to simulate the mewing of a *cat*.
貍屬。从豸苗聲。
A variant form# of 毘 connect + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → beast (most likely a leopard/panther) trained to leap on enemies → *fierce beast trained for use in battle*. Compare 貅.
豹屬，出貉國。从豸𣬉聲。《詩》曰：“獻其貔皮。”《周書》曰：“如虎如貔。”貔，猛獸。
似熊而黃黑色，出蜀中。从豸莫聲。
區 here an abbreviated form# of 毆 strike + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → *tiger/tiger-like beast* trained for use in battle (compare 貅 and 貔).
貙獌，似貍者。从豸區聲。
貙屬也。从豸單聲。
野豕也。从豸雚聲。
纱玃也。从豸矍聲。

A depiction of a bivalve (one split open to reveal its contents) → *shellfish*; (sea) *shell* → *treasure*. When used in dual-element characters, 貝 most often denotes "commodities" (shells having anciently been used as currency), but this is not an independent meaning in Japanese.
海介蟲也。居陸名猋，在水名蜬。象形。古者貨貝而寶龜，周而有泉，至秦廢貝行錢。凡貝之屬皆从貝。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 卜 divination + an abbreviated form# of 鼎 tripod kettle/cauldron → inspect smoke rising from an upright vessel to divine the future → *rectitude* (← upright) → *righteous*; *chastity*.
卜問也。从卜，貝以爲贄。一曰鼎省聲。京房所說。

The crouching figure described in 危 + 貝# commodities → stoop to *carry goods on one's back* → *carry*; *bear* (a load) → *be burdened*; *be shouldered with* (responsibility); *owe*; *sustain* (an injury); *turn one's back to/upon*; *go against* → *lose*; *be defeated*; *succumb* (to); *flee* (← be defeated in battle, then turn to flee; compare 北).
恃也。从人守貝，有所恃也。一曰受貸不償。
An abbreviated form# of 材 (raw) material + 貝 commodities → resources of value → *property*; *wealth*.
人所寶也。从貝才聲。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 貝 commodities → goods/tribute offered in connecting differing strata of society → *tribute*; *donate*; *contribute*; *support financially*.
獻功也。从貝工聲。
从人求物也。从貝弋聲。
重次弟物也。从貝也聲。
分# portion + 貝 commodities → apportion one's possessions to the point of *poverty*.
財分少也。从貝从分，分亦聲。
化# transformation + 貝 commodities → *money* transformed into *goods* and vice-versa → *load* (← load of goods).
財也。从貝化聲。
As per 反# (thin sheet) + 貝 commodities → goods laid out on display (compare 舗) on a board → *sales*.
買賤賣貴者。从貝反聲。
As per 今# (contain) + 貝 commodities → greedily keep commodities contained → *greedy*; *covetous*. Compare 嗇 and 贍.
欲物也。从貝今聲。

Originally, a depiction of two rounded seashells, pierced and adhering closely in being strung together → *pierce*; *penetrate*; *go through* (compare 擐). *Consistent* and *carry out* are extended meanings. The present form combines 貝 shell/commodities + 毌#, a depiction of a cowrie shell (distinguish from 毋).
錢貝之貫。从毌、貝。
The relevant seal inscription form is 朿# (stab) + 貝 commodities → the torment of *debts* piled one atop another → *torture*; *condemn*; *censure*; *urge*; *drive up*; *demand*.
求也。从貝朿聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 貝 commodities + a depiction of a square frame → fill a container/storehouse with goods → *storage*; *lay in stock*; *save*. The square frame element came to be written 宁.
積也。从貝宁聲。
世# successive + 貝 commodities → take possession of an object, with payment to follow → *get*; *obtain*; *receive*.
貸也。从貝丗聲。
迻予也。从貝皮聲。
As per 此# (irregular) + 貝 commodities → *pay a fine* (for irregularities) → *treasure*; *property* (← resource from which a fine is paid).
小罰以財自贖也。从貝此聲。漢律：民不繇，貲錢二十二。

Originally 弍: 弋 stake + 二# two → *two* stakes aligned side by side. As with 壱, 参/參, and 拾, this character is used as a substitute for the usual number (in this case, 二) in documents as a precaution against forgery.
副、益也。从貝弍聲。弍，古文二。

The relevant seal inscription form is 貝# commodities + a representation of a pair of hands wrapped about and compressing a large, round bundle → compress *valuable* goods in a bundle → *precious*; *value*; *cherish* → *respect*; *honor*; *noble*.
物不賤也。从貝臾聲。臾，古文蕢。
Abbreviated form of 泛 cover + 貝 commodities → hold down the price of commodities → *devalue*; *depreciate* → *look down on*.
損也。从貝从乏。
As per 罒# net + 貝 commodities → seek to profit by buying (and then selling) → *buy*; *look for*.
市也。从网、貝。《孟子》曰：“登壟斷而网市利。”
代# alternate + 貝 commodities → alternate ownership in lending/loaning → *lend*; *loan*; *rent* → *bill*.
施也。从貝代聲。
賜也。从貝兄聲。
As per 弗# (split) + 貝 commodities → split (= distribute) commodities → *spend* → *funds*; *expenditure*; *waste*; *squander*.
𢿱財用也。从貝弗聲。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 貝 commodities → commodities that secure/fix a loan in place → security; mortgage. Also, *put/stick on*, *paste* and *post* (← fix in place).
以物爲質也。从貝占聲。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 貝 commodities → *bequeath*; *give*; *present* (← bestow a heavy pile of assets).
贈遺也。从貝台聲。經典通用詒。
Variant of 卯# (bend) + 貝 commodities → bend another person to one's demands in trading → *trade*; *business*.
易財也。从貝戼聲。
As per 加# (place atop) + 貝 commodities → congratulatory presents piled high → *congratulations*.
以禮相奉慶也。从貝加聲。

An abbreviated form# of 奔 (spread) + 貝 bivalve shell → *beautiful pattern* spread over a shell → *spotted/dappled/speckled/mottled* (pattern) (for the latter sense, compare 斑) → *beautifully ornamented*. Also, via the image of a bulging/swelling shell, *large*. *Run swiftly* and *valor* in battle are borrowed meanings.
飾也。从貝卉聲。
各 here an abbreviated form# of 洛 (connect) + 貝 commodities → connections obtained through gifting/bribery → *bribe*.
遺也。从貝各聲。
As per 任# (encompass responsibility) + 貝 commodities → goods/money paid to someone employed, who bears responsibility → *employ*; *hire* → *rent* (to/from); *wages*; *charge*.
庸也。从貝任聲。
As per 有# (extend) + 貝 commodities → extend a *bribe* (compare 賕) → *finance*; *supply*; *offer*; *provide*; *serve*; *boarding* (← extend incentives to obtain labor or other services ).
財也。从貝有聲。
As per 次# (align) + 貝 commodities → have one's assets in proper alignment → *resources*/*capital* → *grounds*; *basis*; *one's nature*; *financial assistance*.
貨也。从貝次聲。
As per 襾# (covered container) + 貝 commodities → commodities in a covered container → *buy*; *trade*; *merchant*.
賈市也。从貝襾聲。一曰坐賣售也。
The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element is a variant# of 戎 (seize goods). 賊 adds 貝 commodities (for emphasis/clarification) → seize goods → *plunder*; *bandit*; *thief*.
敗也。从戈則聲。
頸飾也。从二貝。

辰 here an abbreviated form# of 振 invigorate + 貝 commodities → material assistance enabling another to *flourish* and *be prosperous*. *Bustle* (← bustling prosperity) and *relieve* (another person's distress) (← cause to prosper) are associated meanings.
富也。从貝辰聲。

The two elements at the top of the relevant bronzeware inscription form represent a character# combining 宀 roof/building + 豕 pig/boar → throng of pigs inside a pigpen. 賓 adds 貝 commodities → throng of gift-bearing guests, in close contact → (honored) *visitor*; *guest*.
所敬也。从貝𡧍聲。
求# request + 貝 commodities → accompany a request with commodities → *bribe*. Compare 賄.
以財物枉法相謝也。从貝求聲。一曰戴質也。
貰買也。从貝余聲。
來 here an abbreviated form# of 勑 reward + 貝 commodities → *confer* a reward → *give*; *bestow*; *gift bestowed on one* (by a superior).
賜也。从貝來聲。《周書》曰：“賚尒秬鬯。”
As per 易# (stretch flat) + 貝 commodities → *bestow* goods on a subordinate lying prone in obeisance → *grant*; *give* → *deign to*.
予也。从貝易聲。
As per 尚# (disperse) + 貝 commodities → disburse (= disperse) a *reward* → *prize* → *praise*; *appreciation*.
賜有功也。从貝尚聲。

As per 咅# (spread) + 貝 commodities → spread money or payment in kind to provide full *compensation* for the original value of a (lost/destroyed) object → *indemnity*. For the correlation of the concept "spread" with the meaning "compensate," compare 補.
庚# firm + 貝 commodities → firm, uninterrupted supply/chain of commodities → *continue without interruption*.
As per 臤# (adhere) + 貝 commodities → tightly packed collection of valuable goods → estimable (← goods worthy of esteem) → *wisdom*/*intelligence* (← wise enough to evaluate properly).
多才也。从貝臤聲。
The relevant seal inscription form combines 買# (seek to profit) + 出 proceed → go out to seek profits by selling → *sell*; *make money* → *be in demand*.
出物貨也。从出从買。
As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 貝 commodities → low-grade commodities of slight worth → *cheap*; *shabby*; *inferior* → *contemptible* → *poverty* (← substandard or contemptible living conditions).
賈少也。从貝戔聲。
武# military + 貝 commodities → *levy* imposed to *endow* *troops* with supplies → *taxation*; *payment*; *tribute* → *ode*/*poem* (← poem offered in tribute).
斂也。从貝武聲。
南蠻賦也。从貝宗聲。

斦 is 斤 ax doubled, emphasizing splitting. 質 adds 貝, here an abbreviated form# of 實 (house full of treasures) → split one's belongings → *pawn* → *hostage*; *mortgage* → *quality/content*; *nature*; *verify*; *ask* → *simple* (← simple reality).
以物相贅。从貝从斦。闕。
As per 者# (pile) + 貝 commodities → actual or figurative pile of goods being *bet*/wagered → *wager*; *gamble* → *take a chance*.
博簺也。从貝者聲。
會禮也。从貝纬聲。

束 here an abbreviated form# of 剌 (sharp) + an element combining 貝 commodities and a variant of 人 person → person who suffers a sharp reduction in circumstances, and pleads for material relief → *ask*; *request* → *entrust*; *depend/rely on*; *count on*. Also, *call in/on* (a specialist), *dependable* and *reliable*.
贏也。从貝剌聲。
As per 冐/冒# (wrap about) + 貝 commodities → *wrapped present* (sent on the occasion of a death).
贈死者。从貝从冒。冒者，衣衾覆冒之意。
物相增加也。从貝朕聲。一曰送也，副也。
兼# (gather then put/store away) + 貝 commodities → *make money* then store it away → *swindle* (← make money by deceptive means) → *coax*; *humor* (another).
As per 尃# as described in 博 (spread) + 貝 commodities → a spread of commodities, particularly, *mourning gifts*.
助也。从貝尃聲。
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 貝 commodities → transact business so that both parties are in perfect agreement → *purchase*; *buy*.
以財有所求也。从貝冓聲。
An abbreviated form# of 塞 fill + 貝 commodities → *compete* to fill a container with offerings → *visit a temple/shrine* and make an offering. Also, *dice* (← game of competition).
報也。从貝，塞省聲。
